annotations.title: Change what a journal prints in its numbers

description: Sets the prefix one journal prints in place of {CODE} in the numbers it draws — FAC instead of SAL, for instance — or puts its code back with null. The journal keeps its code and its counter: the series goes on at the next number. A prefix another journal of the company already prints is refused. The pattern around it (year, width) is the company's number_format in update_company_profile. Needs settings.write.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

journal_code.description: The journal by its code, e.g. SAL. get_company lists the journals.

number_prefix.description: What {CODE} prints in the numbers this journal draws, e.g. FAC. Null prints the journal's code again. The code itself never changes.

name: set_number_prefix
